title: Inventaire Amélioré
description: Adds new ores, armors, unbreakable blocks, a custom dimension, and more to expand your Minecraft survival experience.
body:
📦 Inventaire-Amélioré

Inventaire-Amélioré is a Minecraft mod created with MCreator that expands the game with a wide variety of new survival-friendly features, focused on building, exploration, and progression. This mod is designed to feel like a natural extension of vanilla Minecraft while introducing powerful tools and new creative opportunities.

🔧 Key Features

🧱 Advanced Building Blocks
Adds unbreakable and ghost variants of many common blocks such as stone, glass, quartz, and more.
These blocks can be walked through and are perfect for maps, traps, or creative builds.
🛠️ New Ores & Equipment
Introduces two new ores:
Plus Ore
Best Ore
Each ore includes a complete set of armor and tools, balanced for survival gameplay.
All items are craftable using new recipes.
🌀 Custom Portal & Thematic Armor
A unique block with the Nether portal texture acts as a new special block.
Comes with a custom armor set visually matching the portal block.
🌍 New Worlds to Explore
A completely new dimension built using the unbreakable blocks, offering unique environments and possibilities.
A new biome in the End, bringing variety and more exploration content to late-game worlds.
🏗️ Other Additions
A fun and functional trampoline block to bounce players upward.
A decorative French flag block.
New custom villager trades integrated into the economy.
📦 Compatibility

Designed for Minecraft 1.20.1 (or your actual version)
Forge mod loader
Java 17 required
Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer
Crafting recipes are included for all new items and blocks
💡 Why Use This Mod?

Inventaire-Amélioré is perfect for:

Builders who want creative new block types
Survival players looking for late-game goals and gear
Modpack creators seeking vanilla-style content additions
Players who enjoy exploring custom dimensions and biomes
